title: Second batch of spelling & grammar fixes
body:
Pointed an AI agent at every Markdown file in the repo modulo compiled ones (manpages targeted `.md.in` instead of `.md` and similar), and asked it to identify spelling & grammar fixes. The result is too big for a single PR, so I'm batching it into chunks that should be small enough for manual review. This is the second round of those.

There are, unfortunately, still something like 1000 lines in the cumulative list of potential changes. Maybe I should increase the file batch size to 30-40?
